ctx.x: No … with David and uh uh Bobby's drummer whose name, name uh escapes me right now. Uh … Eddie Marshall. He's a very good drummer. But he's always been in the Bay Area. Then I'll be finished with that group, you know, 'cause Bobby, you know, Bobby has a group and I have a group, so that's enough of that. We, we did a lot,…
